title: GovEagle adds Discover to federal opportunity search
summary: Opportunity Search in GovEagle is now Discover. It ranks new federal listings by how well they fit your company, with saved searches and a daily email.
body_markdown:
Opportunity Search is now called Discover. Tell it about your company once, and it ranks new federal listings by how well they fit. Discover is in beta.


## What changed


Opportunity Search ran on bid agents. Discover starts from a company profile:


- **A profile for each company you bid as.** Share a website or your UEI, or write the description yourself. A division or subsidiary gets its own profile, searches and matches, so its results don't crowd out yours.
- **Saved searches replace bid agents.** Your existing bid agents carry over as saved searches, with their names and filters.
- **Filter by who's buying.** Narrow any search by agency, subagency or office, using the full list of federal agencies.
- **One email each morning.** Each search can send its new matches in a daily email, and you can pause any search's email at any time.
- **Decide as a team.** Mark a listing **Not interested** with a reason your teammates can see, ask a colleague for a second look, or paste a SAM.gov or GovWin link to check a listing you found elsewhere.


## Who it helps


Capture and BD leads who review new listings every day, and firms that bid through more than one business unit.


## How Discover works


1. Select **Discover** in the left sidebar and choose a company.
2. Set up the company: the work you want, your filters, and what isn't a fit.
3. Review **Matches** , sorted by **Business Fit** . Hover over a score to read why a listing ranks where it does.
4. Click **Add to pipeline** to turn a listing into an opportunity, or **Not interested** to set it aside.


Get GovCon capture and proposal insights in your inbox.


## Where it fits


Discover is part of[GovEagle's capture workspace](https://www.goveagle.com/solutions/bd-capture) . Listings come from SAM.gov and PIEE, plus GovWin and GSA eBuy for teams that connect them. For building a pipeline that reaches past the public notices, read[federal pipeline tracking beyond SAM.gov](https://www.goveagle.com/blog/federal-pipeline-tracking) .


## What it doesn't do


- **Scores don't make the decision.** P-Win is an early estimate. Read the listing's requirements before you commit.
- **All matches doesn't combine companies.** Each company has its own matches, scores and decisions.
- **Not every filter saves.** Search text, due date, posted date and opportunity value apply to the current list but aren't saved with a search. Use the Keywords filter for terms you want to keep.


## Get started


Discover is in beta. To turn it on for your organization, emailsupport@goveagle.com .
